I was fully expecting this product to be a failure for me, but I am pleasantly surprised to say that this is the ONLY toner that has not exacerbated my rosacea. I use it after cleaning and before using my regular moisturizer and sunscreen, and I have no increased redness, no pustules, and no heat flushing. Since a viral infection three years ago, my skin has been extremely reactive to both niacinamide and all forms of hyaluronic acid, but this toner seems to be the exception to the rule. I wish it was a bit more hydrating, but I'm going to give the cream a try and see if that is more hydrating and just as calming. Aesthetically, I enjoy that the glass bottle has a heftiness that feels like a luxury product, and the screw-on cap is large enough to not accidentally fly out of my hand. I'll be repurchasing this toner.
